title: Water and Sewage Corporations Law, 5761-2001
source_id: Sefer HaChukim 5761 (ס״ח תשס״א), p 454; Wikisource page: חוק תאגידי מים וביוב
verified_how: Fetched the Wikisource page and its raw wikitext. Page title is exactly חוק תאגידי מים וביוב; heading prints חוק תאגידי מים וביוב, התשס״א–2001. Header citation box reads {{ח:תיבה|ס״ח תשס״א, 454|חוק תאגידי מים וביוב|https://fs.knesset.gov.il/15/law/15_lsr_300397.pdf}}. Confirmed the charging provisions on the page: סימן ז׳: קביעת כללים לחישוב עלות ותעריפים (rules for cost calculation and tariffs), s 102 as the tariff-setting power, and ss 31 and 33 obliging a corporation to supply water and sewage services in accordance with tariffs set under s 102, without discrimination and subject to the service standards under s 99. Highest-year amendment box is ס״ח תשפ״ו, 286 (Amendment No 19), https://fs.knesset.gov.il/25/law/25_lsr_11338829.pdf.
notes: This is the instrument a household water bill is issued under: since the reform, municipal water and sewage supply is run by corporations licensed under this Law, charging tariffs set by the Water Authority under s 102. Two cautions. (1) Partial future commencement: the consolidation shows amendment provisions keyed to a מועד קובע (determining date) of 22 Tevet 5787 (1 January 2027), so some of the current text is future-dated and an encoder must pin an as-at date. (2) As with electricity, the billing detail — meter readings, consumption bands, arrears, restriction of supply — is set out in Water Authority rules (כללי תאגידי מים וביוב) made under the Law rather than in the Law itself. The Wikisource page's last-edited timestamp was not exposed in the rendered header; the ס״ח תשפ״ו, 286 amendment box is the best currency marker recorded.
